# Price the drive and the stations, not the house.

> Price a pest control route stop from on-site minutes, bait stations, and drive time — not house size. See initial vs recurring invoices, effective hourly with the drive, and how many stops recover a free initial.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
